parts.sourceFrame: robot frame (mm, x forward, y left, z up)
parts.poseOrigin: back-plate/layout-F/build.json printPoses.lid and back-plate/layout-F/rear_lid-print.stl: outer rear face (robot x -67.1) on the bed, x' = y, y' = z, z' = x; 2634.0 mm2 bed contact, 15.5 mm tall over the column fronts, rim at 7.7 mm (open side up, no tongues). The rounded rear edges (R 4.3..8.0) leave the bed at a shallow angle: tree support under them. The four screw columns stand vertical with their driver holes open on the bed face and floors bridging over the dia 2.3 clearance holes. The open side cannot go down because the four screw columns stand up to 7.8 mm proud of the rim.

parts.changeReason: D-034 (Shawn 2026-10-29: "降压板背包盖子 打螺丝的时候直接把螺丝挡板打下来了", "为什么不贴着板子", "出文件"): the four screw columns run onto the boards (low pair to the 5991 PCB face x -51.6, top pair to the 7 V XL4015 hole pads x -51.86) and the cap rim stops 0.3 mm short of the frame rim, so the columns locate the cap and the screws press each floor onto a board instead of pulling it across a gap. Floors 4.5 mm (low) and 3.74 mm (top); seats, the four M2 x 10 and their thread engagement unchanged; the 7 V board is now clamped at its top corners. Ray-checked: column fronts within 0.06 mm of the board on 99-100 % of the annulus, nearest other board part 4.65 mm from a column axis, cap 0.249 mm from the frame at the closest (the flattened top columns, as V1.20). Print gate passed 2026-10-29.
